name: Rimecurrant Ice Cream
description: A dessert served in a glass. Cream, milk, honey, and crushed berries are mixed together, then frozen into smooth, velvety scoops of ice cream. The fruit and dairy flavors blend into a rich, delicious taste, making this a treat some will gladly enjoy no matter the temperature.

suspicious.name: Suspicious Rimecurrant Ice Cream
suspicious.description: A dessert served in a glass. Frozen rock-solid, it takes a monumental effort just to scrape off a tiny sliver with an iron spoon. Once in your mouth, the biting cold sets your teeth chattering instantly. Not a trace of sweetness remains, as if every ounce of flavor never got the chance to take the stage...
suspicious.effect: Revives a character and restores 900 HP.

delicious.name: Delicious Rimecurrant Ice Cream
delicious.description: A dessert served in a glass. Look closely and you can just faintly discern the delicate textures of fruit pulp, looking like a tiny sliver of sunset trapped beneath the ice. While Snezhnaya's frozen climate could easily preserve this sweet scenery for an entire day, its flawless balance of sweet and tart ensures it will be devoured long before then...
delicious.effect: Revives a character and restores 1,500 HP.
